description: Dig into an imagined past with artist Vita Kari, uncovering artifacts that place Deaf and hard-of-hearing experiences at the center of history. Unearthed is a one-day interactive workshop and durational performance by Vita Kari . Participants uncover fabricated listening devices and archival fragments from an imagined past where (d)/Deaf and Hard of Hearing people were always visible. After opening secret compartments embedded in handmade faux rock to reveal the artifacts, visitors receive a thermal-printed field report of their discovery. This take-home record extends the exhibition’s questions of history and memory through the lenses of hearing, accessibility, and disability.
